title: History and Country-of-Origin Effects
eligible_reason: Not a staggered design, and the main data are synthetic. Conflict equals 1 for every county from September 2012 onward (the Diaoyu Islands dispute), a single common date. Invasion is a time-invariant indicator for counties invaded by Japan in WWII. Specifications are Conflict x Invasion DiD by car origin and DDD with Japanese and Chinese brand interactions, with model-time and model-county FE. Further columns add subgroup interactions (price, newer, midsize, recognizable brand, memory proxies).
design_notes: code/AllTablesButTable3.R: felm(log_Amount ~ Conflict:Invasion | model_time + model_county | 0 | County) for all, Japanese, Chinese, American, German and Korean cars (Table 1). DDD with Conflict:Invasion:Japanese + Conflict:Invasion:Chinese, adding county_time FE. Dynamic DDD with Conflict_pre and Conflict_longrun. Heterogeneity DDDs. Logit of protest on Invasion. Table3.py is separate. I verified in the shipped synthetic file that Conflict switches on in 2012-09 for all rows.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. ReadMe.pdf labels the regression data files as synthetic.
